CURRENT SCENE:
一个爬山的男人正好看到神农的麻烦，然后给了他一些药。神农最终他的小镇回到，跟别的人分享他的发现。你认为神农的故事真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处。

ITEMS:

[I229] 神农最终【他的小镇回到】   correction: 他的小镇回到 → 回到他的小镇   strength: error
  checker's note: word order with 回到 is incorrect
  rule card (directional_complements, Grammar): Use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去: put the place after the directional complement and before 来/去. For walking to a place, use 走到place来/去, not 走去 or 走来Place.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: put the place after the directional complement; use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去 (or 走到place来/去).  Her terms: V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去, 走到place来/去, 走去/来Place, 拿起来, 拿上去

  her past correction: 神农回[-他的]家 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 神农一走路就[-走]到了

[I230] 跟【别的人】分享他的发现   correction: 别的人 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 别的人 -> (delete) (corrected 8/8 in train)
  rule card (other_vs_additional, Vocabulary): 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this means an additional/another <noun>, so use 另外, not 别的.  Her terms: 别的, 另外
  her past correction: 告诉[别的人→其他人] — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

  her past correction: 原来他想给[别的人→别人]建议

[I231] 你认为神农的故事【^】真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处   correction: ∅ → 是   strength: error
  checker's note: 是 is needed before the adjective question
  rule card (modifier_de_structure, Grammar): Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <modifier> describes the noun <noun>, so use 的; or <modifier> does not need 的 here, so omit it.  Her terms: no的

[I232] 你认为神农的故事真的吗？这就要【看】你相信中药对身体有好处   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error

  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see

items.explanation: Put the place after 回到: use V. + directional complement + Place. Say 回到他的小镇.
Use 别人 for “other people” in general. 别的 is for a different type or all others except one already mentioned.
Use 是 before an adjective question about a noun. Say 神农的故事是真的吗？
Use 看 here, not 看到: this means “it depends on whether you believe,” not actually seeing something. 看look vs. 看到see.
It would be more natural to add 是否 after 看 to introduce the two possibilities: whether you believe it or not.
